content: 1. Administer paromomycin at a dose of 25-35 mg/kg/day orally, divided every 6 hours, for a duration of 5-10 days. This regimen is effective for acute and chronic conditions but not for extraintestinal infections. 2. For certain conditions, a dose of 4 g orally per day, divided into multiple doses, is recommended for 5-6 days. 3. Another dosing option includes 20-30 mg/kg/day orally, divided every 8 hours. 4. For specific indications, administer 11 mg/kg orally, divided every 15 minutes, for a total of 4 doses. 5. A dose of 45 mg/kg/day orally, given once daily, is effective for 5-7 days. 6. For the treatment of cutaneous leishmaniasis (both Old World and New World types), administer 25-35 mg/kg/day orally, divided every 8 hours, for 7 days. Alternatively, 750 mg/m²/day orally, divided every 6 hours, can be used for 5 days. 7. Paromomycin increases the effects of atracurium through pharmacodynamic synergism, which may lead to an increased risk of apnea. Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative drugs. 8. Paromomycin and axicabtagene ciloleucel may mutually enhance each other's immunosuppressive effects, increasing the risk of infection. Avoid concurrent use or consider alternative therapies. 9. Paromomycin decreases the efficacy of live BCG vaccine through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Administration of live bacterial vaccines should be delayed until antibiotic therapy is completed. 10.
